name: Marrow

poster.hook: Strong back, steady hands. Will not go near the lifeboat shed. Do not ask why.

story.appearance: Seven feet of blue-grey goliath, bald, with a pale lightning-scar pattern running up both forearms. Wears a threadbare coxswain's coat, hauls a salvage axe over one shoulder, and keeps a loop of cord with seven knots around his wrist.
story.concept: Marrow was coxswain of the Saltmere lifeboat until the night the Tern went down eleven years ago. He came back with one rescued child and without a single one of his crew. Now he hauls nets, breaks up fights, and mends boats he refuses to sail.
story.stake: Seven of the drowned walking up the beach tonight are his crew. He knows their names, and they know his.
story.goal: Walk down the beach to them first and put them back to sleep, whatever it costs.
story.secret: The line didn't part. The lifeboat was lashed to the Tern's stern when a wave stood up, and Marrow cut the lashing with a hatchet while seven of his crew were still aboard the wreck. He told the town it snapped. He plans to be the one who stays at the rope tonight, and he hasn't told a soul.
story.voice: Slow, gravelly, few words, each one weighed. Talks about people the way sailors talk about weather: 'bad water ahead', 'she's turning'.
mannerisms: Rubs the seven knots on his wrist with his thumb
Waits for everyone else to board a boat before he does
Always stands upwind and a step in front of the smallest person present
story.trinket: A notched boat-hatchet on a cord around his neck, which he won't explain

ties.text: Broke his arm over a debt two winters ago, then paid the healer's bill himself. Grudging friends since; he keeps lending money he knows won't come back.
ties.public: Broke his arm over a debt once; grudging friends since

ties.text: She buried the five of his crew the bay gave back. He leaves a coin on each grave every storm night, and she pretends not to see.
ties.public: She tends the graves of his lost crew

ties.text: The only person he brought home from the Tern, blue and not breathing. He looks away when she looks at him. He thinks she saw.
ties.public: Pulled her from the wreck of the Tern

story.intro: "Marrow. I pull things out of the water. People, mostly. Not many, lately."

features.name: Giant Ancestry: Storm's Thunder
features.text: Reaction: when a creature within 60 ft damages you, deal 1d8 Thunder damage to it.

features.name: Large Form
features.text: Bonus Action: grow to Large for up to 10 minutes if there is room. You gain Advantage on Strength checks and +10 ft Speed.

features.name: Powerful Build
features.text: You have Advantage on checks to escape being grappled and count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

features.name: Tavern Brawler
features.text: Your unarmed strike does 1d4 + Str, you reroll 1s on its damage, you can push a target 5 ft on a hit during the Attack action, and you are proficient with improvised weapons.

features.name: Great Weapon Master
features.text: Add your proficiency bonus to damage when you hit with a Heavy weapon in the Attack action on your turn. After a crit or dropping a foe to 0 HP in melee on your turn, make a bonus-action attack with the same weapon.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: Bonus Action: regain 1d10 + 5 HP. You regain one use on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: Take one additional action on your turn (not Magic).

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.text: After failing an ability check, spend a use of Second Wind to add 1d10 to it; if it still fails, the use isn't spent.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: Make two attacks whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.text: When you use Second Wind, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.text: You can use the mastery property of four weapon types: Greataxe, Maul, Pike, and Javelin.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.text: You have four d8 Superiority Dice, regained on a Short or Long Rest, and know three maneuvers. Maneuver save DC 15 (Str).

features.name: Maneuver: Parry
features.text: Reaction when hit by a melee attack: reduce the damage by your die roll + Str modifier.

features.name: Maneuver: Riposte
features.text: Reaction when a creature misses you in melee: make a melee attack against it, adding your die to the damage.

features.name: Maneuver: Pushing Attack
features.text: When you hit with a weapon attack, add the die to damage; a Large or smaller target must make a Str save or be pushed up to 15 ft.

features.name: Student of War
features.text: You gained Carpenter's Tools and Survival proficiency.

flashback: What do you say to the coin before you set it on a crewman's grave on a storm night?

ifUnclaimed.npc: Run Marrow as a silent figure walking down the beach toward the drowned in Act 1, nets still on his shoulder, refusing help. In Act 4 he turns up at the rope uninvited, and no one can talk him off it until the party gives him a better reason.

reassign.beat: The seven drowned crew, by name (and Hob's note at the end of Act 1)
reassign.text: You know the Tern's crew by name: Hob Tarrant, Edda Kell, Wick Sorrel, Joss Marl, Nan Rudd, Dunstan Greer, Little Ferris. If one of them speaks to you tonight, answer them by name.

reassign.beat: Volunteers to stay at the rope in Act 4
reassign.text: You have already decided that someone must stay at the rope, and that it ought to be you. You have told nobody. You think it would make things even.

reassign.beat: The hatchet: the lashing never snapped
reassign.text: You were the child on the Tern. You saw the lashing cut, and you saw who cut it. If the drowned ask who parted the line, you are the only living witness.

cuts: The lifeboat-shed scene and the coin-on-the-grave ritual.
Marrow facing his old crew by name on the beach in Act 1; they simply shamble toward the town instead.
